rubrics.criterion: Agent opens Cheskepdia and reads the live Philadelphia overnight hotel booking (property name as shown on the Cheskepdia booking record), reporting its total price and dates as shown live

Agent cross-references Gringotts around the Philadelphia overnight trip dates (as read from the Cheskepdia booking) for the related card charges the ledger shows live — the hotel line (which on this bake matches the Cheskepdia booking's property name and posts on the check-in day, so an exact-name match is expected rather than an alias), plus on-trip incidentals such as the eTaxi rides between Scranton and Philadelphia, gas, or food. Any defensible set of charges the live ledger shows around those dates is acceptable; the agent is not required to hunt for a differently-named hotel merchant.
Agent reports the combined Philadelphia trip total (hotel + any on-trip card charges) as the all-in damage Michael asked for
Agent states the Philadelphia trip all-in damage as a single final dollar figure combining the hotel and incidentals (not assuming a flight)

task.instruction: What did that recent Philadelphia overnight trip cost me all-in? It was a quick one-night hotel stay downtown. Give me the damage from the hotel and any related card charges.
